messages:
Maya (PM): dropped a compact card mock for pool "glance" that surfaces burst headroom, min/max, and an SLO micro-slider. goal: make decisions in one line without expanding the card Liam (Designer): nice. can we add a tiny stat for estimated burst impact (relative p50/p95 delta)? show as +X% or +Yms on hover Anne (Frontend): hover works visually but add keyboard-expand fallback. also contrast: burst pill on dark mode fails WCAG AA currently Samir (SRE): if we show numbers, they must be estimated per-model. recommend showing relative delta text like "~ +25ms (est.)" and a tooltip: "Based on recent traces for selected model" Liam (Designer): updated copy: "Burst impact (est.)" with a chevron for details. small info icon with aria-describedby for screen readers Maya (PM): microcopy choices: "Burst headroom" vs "Burst available". which is clearer when we also show a tiny capacity gauge? Anne (Frontend): "Burst available" reads like a resource. but for screen readers add aria-label: "Burst available, estimated latency increase and cost". make CTA focusable Samir (SRE): behavior note: when pool burst == 0, show inline warning: "No burst available 94 spikes may queue" and include action "Pick pool with burst" that opens pool selector Liam (Designer): wording: "Pick pool with burst" better than generic "Switch pool". also propose small rescue tip: "Enable burst in Dedicated configs" for eligible customers Maya (PM): flagging privacy: Dedicated customers can see exact headroom numbers; hosted gets smoothed estimates. @ops-bot add rollout flag note ops-bot: created INF-5199 (burst-glance-flag) assigned to @Samir, label: feature-rollout :white_check_mark: Anne (Frontend): accessibility snippet: ensure the warning uses role=alert so it's announced: ```
No burst available 94 requests may queue
``` and ensure keyboard users can open details with Enter/Space Liam (Designer): UI layout nit: min/max steppers compete with SLO slider in narrow widths. suggestion: collapse to inline compact steppers when width < 420px and show full controls on focus Maya (PM): what about SLO presets? users loved quick presets in research but need free edits for power users Samir (SRE): default to medium preset; show low/medium/high chips. slider snaps to chips but users can override. show numeric SLO in tooltip and aria-valuetext that reads "Medium (99.5%)" Anne (Frontend): add prefers-reduced-motion support for slider animations. implement aria-live update for numeric changes so assistive tech hears the new value when adjusted Liam (Designer): I'll push updated mock: compact card, relative latency delta, improved contrast, collapsed steppers, new warning copy, and visible presets. will add an alt text description for the card for docs Maya (PM): great. can Samir/Anne estimate dev effort by EOD? I'll attach mock + INF-5199 and link to the spec Samir (SRE): will add rough ETA to INF-5199 by 5pm Anne (Frontend): will add frontend breakdown and prototype notes Maya (PM): thanks team 94 landing this in the next sprint if estimates look good :thumbsup:
